notes.title: ThunderGod v1.0.3 [Patch]
notes.content:
We've updated ThunderGod with some minor bugfixes:

- Ragnarök level has been shortened and tweaked for better gameplay (previous high scores for this level will be wiped, unfortunately)
- Fixed an issue where giants could get stuck in the river
- Giants will walk away from the player in the Game Over state, instead of crawling on the ground
- Fixed bug where you would get time bonus in failstate of Ragnarök
- Fixed so that "Grab Mjolnir" isn't visible if pausing the game
- Fixed so that buttons wont highlight in the level select when holding hammer

notes.title: ThunderGod v1.0.2 [Patch]
notes.content:
We've updated ThunderGod with some minor bugfixes:

- Fixed issue where the hammer drops to the ground if grabbed by second hand while held with first hand
- Fixed bug where if you select level 3 and then select 1, would set max fog as soon as first giant was killed
- Fixed speed of summoned hammer after a "failed" throw (physics mode) to go faster
